rationale: Dcx (434 CPM), Sox11 (72), Sox4, Dlx1 and Igfbpl1 fit migrating neuroblasts or immature interneurons. But the cluster has a low median gene count (~1,030), mixed old labels, Gad1 577 and some Ppp1r1b/Isl1 (113 each), so it is more likely SVZ/RMS or LGE-lineage neuroblasts next to the striatal piece than cortical cells. rationale: Pooled CPM is dominated by neutrophil granule/calprotectin transcripts: S100a9 10,667, S100a8 3,076, Ngp 2,341, Camp 602, Mmp9 568, Retnlg 234. The monocyte/APC (Lyz2, Cd74, RT1-Da) and lymphoid (Cd79a 268, Cd3e 234) signals are weaker, so this is most likely intravascular neutrophils or a mixed blood-leukocyte cluster, not monocytes. Plac8 and Ifitm1, the cited markers, are also high in neutrophils. Relabel as 'Neutrophils' or 'Blood leukocytes (mixed)', or drop it (29 cells).

rationale: Median 243 genes, against 1,200-3,200 in retained clusters. Mt-co1 is ~9,900 CPM, against 800-1,400 in good neuronal clusters, and mitochondrial transcripts should be nearly absent from intact nuclei. Markers from several lineages appear together (Plp1 6,217, Ptgds 2,553, Slc17a7 971, Gfap 332) and spread evenly over 6 samples, which is the profile of ambient 'soup' or empty droplets that passed a lenient cell call. That ~91% of barcodes are affected says the upstream cell calling was too permissive (EmptyDrops/CellBender would likely have removed them). It is not an argument to keep them.

rationale: Gad1 816 with Adarb2, Reln, Erbb4, Dlx1, Npas1, Htr3a, Vip 597, Lamp5 108 and Prox1 145 is a CGE-derived interneuron profile. PROX1 lineage-traces LGE/CGE interneurons that co-express VIP/reelin/calretinin. A narrower label, 'CGE interneurons (Vip/Lamp5)', would be justified.

rationale: It is mainly microglia: Csf1r 1,826, Cx3cr1 1,075, Tmem119 250, P2ry12 154, Sall1 614. However, pooled Mrc1 377, Cd163 174 and F13a1 278 CPM sit well above background (single digits elsewhere), so a BAM subpopulation is inside. The review's claim of 'no Mrc1/Cd163 among the markers' holds for the top-marker list but not for the CPMs. Tmem119 is absent from meningeal/choroid-plexus macrophages, which supports splitting. Sub-cluster, or label 'Microglia (+BAM admixture)'.
citations: Bennett 2016 PNAS 113:E1738 https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4812770 (Tmem119 parenchymal microglia, not CP/meningeal macrophages); Van Hove 2019 Nat Neurosci doi:10.1038/s41593-019-0393-4 (BAM subsets; gene list not verified)

rationale: The thalamic transcription factors are strongly enriched: Lef1 521 and Tcf7l2 183 CPM, against single digits in the hippocampal neuron clusters. Slc17a6 (130), Ntng1 (617), Synpo2 and Plekhg1 are also enriched. LEF1/TCF7L2 protein is highest in thalamus and absent from hippocampal neurons, and TCF7L2 is the shared marker of prosomere-2 (thalamus/habenula) neurons. Gad1 281 and Slc32a1 113 are far below the real interneuron clusters (816-1,561). With 72% of cells from one sample, this is most likely a thalamic/habenular dissection contaminant, possibly excitatory+inhibitory mixed, not hippocampal interneurons. Relabel as 'Thalamic neurons (contaminant)' and exclude or K2-flag.
citations: Nagalski 2012 Brain Struct Funct doi:10.1007/s00429-012-0474-6 (LEF1/TCF7L2 highest in thalamus; no LEF1 in hippocampal formation - verified); Lipiec 2020 Development doi:10.1242/dev.190181 (TCF7L2 marks prosomere-2 thalamo-habenular neurons - verified)

rationale: Slc17a7 516, Snap25 1,909, Wfs1 151, Mpped1 116, with no Prox1 (5) and no Gad1 (15): a principal-neuron profile. Leaving the subfield undecided is appropriate. Keep the K2 flag for the 80% single-sample share.

rationale: Flt1 1,049, Slc2a1, Abcb1a, Epas1 and Cxcl12 are genuine BBB-endothelial markers (Cldn5 and Pecam1 are absent from this rat gene space). However, at median 468 genes with Mt-co1 13,049, Plp1 3,674, Ptgds 2,672 and Gfap 777 CPM, these are low-quality endothelial nuclei with heavy ambient load. Keep only if the deconvolution signature tolerates them; otherwise merge into or replace with the clean j13.0/j13.8 endothelium.
citations: Vanlandewijck 2018 Nature doi:10.1038/nature25739 (brain EC atlas; gene list not verified); Fleming 2023 Nat Methods doi:10.1038/s41592-023-01943-7 (ambient contamination)

rationale: Atp13a5 (a CNS-pericyte-specific marker), Abcc9, Kcnj8 102, Vtn 375 and Pdgfrb 443 support pericytes. But Slc6a13 (733), Slc22a6/Slc22a8, Tbx18 and Col3a1 are present at fibroblast-like levels, so with only 40 cells the cluster is probably a pericyte–fibroblast mixture or doublets, as the rule flagged. rationale: Flt1 684, Epas1, Igfbp7, Cxcl12 and Hip1 show an endothelial signal. But median 487 genes, Ptgds 8,552 and Mt-co1 11,255 CPM, together with astro ambient genes (Atp1a2, S100b, Gja1, Apoe) among the top markers, mean these are low-quality endothelial nuclei. They are better merged with the clean endothelium (j13.0/j13.8) or dropped.

rationale: Slc47a1 (888), Bnc2, Prrx2, Alx1, Foxd1, Col8a2 and Slco2a1 give a meningeal fibroblast profile. Slc47a1 is reported as a meningeal-fibroblast transporter and appears as arachnoid-barrier-cell evidence in the Allen mouse taxonomy, but I found no primary paper establishing it, and Crabp2 is low (34). The broad VLMC label is acceptable; the arachnoid/dural subtype is unverified.

rationale: The GABAergic signal is genuine (Gad1 1,561, Slc32a1 1,393, Sst 3,508). But the median is 513 genes, Mt-co1 4,930 and Plp1 1,995 CPM, and Pvalb, Vip and Ndnf all appear together, so this is a low-quality, mixed-subclass interneuron cluster. The label is fine, but these nuclei are weaker than j16/j22.
citations: Caglayan 2022 Neuron doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2022.09.010 (ambient/damaged nuclei); Tasic 2018 Nature doi:10.1038/s41586-018-0654-5

rationale: Havcr1 (Kim-1) on a Lrp2+ PT background is the injured-PT signature of Kirita 2020, and CDH6 marks injured/dedifferentiated PT (Aggarwal 2024); but Vcam1 (4 CPM) and Krt20 (0) are absent, so the failed-repair/severe-injury states are not supported, and Cdh6 is not specific here (j0 202 vs j2 230 CPM). Havcr1 is also only 31 CPM. A better label would be 'PT, injured/dedifferentiated (Havcr1+)'. Cldn1 is mildly raised (28 vs 1-12 CPM), so a parietal-epithelial admixture can't be excluded; I found no PEC marker source to test this.
citations: Kirita Y et al. 2020 PNAS 117:15874, doi:10.1073/pnas.2005477117; Aggarwal S et al. 2024 Science, doi:10.1126/science.add6371

rationale: Doublet call is reasonable: the cluster carries S3 PT (Slc7a13 4848, Lrp2 3674) and TAL (Slc12a1 3358 = about 19% of the TAL cluster, Umod 427) together, both segments of the outer stripe, and curated lineage-marker doublet removal is the practice in Kirita 2020. Caveat: the 'about 1.5x genes' argument is weak, because the S3 PT clusters themselves are gene-rich (j8 3069, j7 2355 vs j3 3337), so the TAL co-expression carries the call. The top markers it shares with j8 (Cpxm2, Acvr1c, Gcm1, Slc38a3) fit S3+TAL doublets or high-ambient S3.
citations: Kirita Y et al. 2020 PNAS, doi:10.1073/pnas.2005477117; Ransick A et al. 2019 Dev Cell (S3 Slc7a13), bioRxiv doi:10.1101/673335

rationale: Low-quality call is sound: median 324 genes, and the top markers are only the 13 mitochondrially encoded genes (a nuclear prep with high mito reads is a standard exclusion; Kirita 2020 removed nuclei with mito UMI fraction >= 1%).
citations: Kirita Y et al. 2020 PNAS, doi:10.1073/pnas.2005477117; Luecken MD & Theis FJ 2019 Mol Syst Biol, doi:10.15252/msb.20188746

rationale: Slc7a13 is very high (8252 CPM, the highest of any cluster) with Lrp2 4665, and Slc7a13 marks the S3 PT in the outer stripe (Ransick 2019). The S3-PT label is well supported. The high gene count (3069) matches the other S3 cluster j7, so it is not a doublet signal.

rationale: Low-quality call is sound: median 541 genes, markers are ribosomal and housekeeping only (Rps*, Eef1a1, Gapdh, Gpx1, Mif) with no lineage genes, the usual empty/damaged-nucleus profile; 94% were labelled PT before, consistent with PT ambient RNA.
citations: Luecken MD & Theis FJ 2019 Mol Syst Biol, doi:10.15252/msb.20188746

rationale: Pdgfra 445 CPM and C7 940 favour fibroblasts over mural cells (Muhl 2020: Pdgfra is missing in mural cells; no single pan-fibroblast/pan-mural gene, so use a signature). But Abcc9 615, Itga8 174 and Myh11 141 suggest pericyte/mesangial admixture, and there is heavy PT ambient (Slc34a1 3849). A better label would be 'Stromal cells (fibroblast-dominant)'; for deconvolution, merging fibroblast+mural is defensible.

Ptprc/Lcp1/Lcp2/Ikzf1/Dock2 are pan-leukocyte genes; the mix of myeloid (Ctss, Ly86) and lymphoid/NK (Klra2 = a rat Ly49 receptor gene; Prkcb, Pou2f2) genes justifies keeping a coarse label at snRNA depth (Kirita 2020 likewise recovered several leukocyte classes from snRNA). No source was looked up for each gene; these are standard leukocyte markers.
citations: Kirita Y et al. 2020 PNAS, doi:10.1073/pnas.2005477117

rationale: Top2a/Mki67/Cenpf/Bub1b is the canonical G2/M program; Kirita 2020 describes a cycling 'repairing PT' state with Top2a up-regulation. The background is PT (Lrp2 2719; 71/107 old PT), so 'Cycling PT cells' would be more precise, although 22 cells were labelled A-IC before.
citations: Kirita Y et al. 2020 PNAS, doi:10.1073/pnas.2005477117

rationale: Doublet call is sound: S1/S2 PT (Slc34a1 20,662, Slc5a2, Slc34a3) together with DCT (Slc12a3 1469 vs about 40-200 in PT clusters, Klhl3, Tmem52b) and TAL (Slc12a1 5090, Umod 662) genes, which are mutually exclusive nephron segments; the median of 2265 genes is about 2x the S1 PT cluster j1 (1069).

rationale: Hepatocyte identity is fine. rationale: Reln is the HSC marker in Lua 2016 (VitA+ HSC express reelin; portal fibroblasts are Entpd2+/elastin+ instead). Lhx2/Colec11/Hgf are consistent; Dobie 2019 is the relevant scRNA reference, but I could not access its marker text.

rationale: Lua 2016 defines liver mesothelial cells as GPM6A+ and expressing mesothelin and uroplakin 1b; Gpm6a, Msln and Upk1b are all among this cluster's top markers (plus Cd200).

rationale: The NK override is supported: Prf1 487, Klrd1 263, Gzma 258, Nkg7 113 with Cd3e only 43, and Cd8a 183 with Cd8b 3 CPM; rat NK cells carry only CD8 alpha chains (CD8aa), while rat CD8 T cells are mostly CD8ab (Torres-Nagel 1992). Caveat: the cluster also carries Kupffer (Cd163 497, Clec4f 247) and hepatocyte (Alb 16,329) signal and was 103/181 'hepatocyte' and 40 'Kupffer' before, so its NK profile is contaminated.

rationale: Ckm, Actn3, Tnnt3, Tnni2, Mybpc2 are fast-fibre myonuclear genes, and Myh4 is 8008 CPM (type IIb; Petrany 2020). Fibre-type myonuclear programs are established in dos Santos 2020 and Petrany 2020. The 'Skeletal muscle cells' umbrella is appropriate for deconvolution.

rationale: Myh4 marks type IIb myonuclei (Petrany 2020); Actn3/Mybpc2/Ampd1 are fast-glycolytic genes.

rationale: The pooled profile is Abcc9 3298, Kcnj8 261, Vtn 204, Pdgfrb 1881, Pdgfra 11, Myh11 412 (vs 9904 in SMC cluster j16). Muhl 2020 (which includes skeletal muscle) describes a pericyte-to-SMC continuum read by Acta2/Myh11/Rgs5/Kcnj8, with Pdgfra absent from mural cells, so this is the pericyte end. rationale: Myh4 is 9021 CPM, with glycolytic/fast genes (Prkag3, Ampd1, Gpd2, Phka1); a fast IIb myonuclear subcluster.
